recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is recommended for FHIR-22131 unless a future work group decision changes the shared CanonicalResource/MetadataResource title model or asks for separate example policy changes.
issue_request: FHIR-22131 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request asking for a human-friendly NamingSystem.title element because NamingSystem.name is intended to be computer-friendly and not suitable as a display label.
initial_application: Commit 25159ea161eaed360cf05d040c52d38e80cdcbac explicitly listed FHIR-22131 among Vocabulary R5 NamingSystem changes and added NamingSystem.title to source/namingsystem/structuredefinition-NamingSystem.xml. Current NamingSystem examples also include title values.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes NamingSystem as a built resource. FHIR-22620 is a duplicate request for the same title element and documents the prior UTG local extension need. Vocab Confluence minutes record the September 2019 action item to add a NamingSystem title element and the July 2020 block-vote listing FHIR-22131 as Persuasive. Targeted Zulip searches found no direct FHIR-22131 discussion or conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/namingsystem/structuredefinition-NamingSystem.xml already defines NamingSystem.title as a 0..1 string with human-friendly title wording, the resource metadata has a title, and the checked examples include title elements.
